description: Convert a docker-compose.yml / compose.yaml into the shell commands that start the same containers without Compose: `docker network create` (the project network when there are several services, plus declared networks), `docker volume create` for volumes with a driver or options, `docker build -t` for services with build:, one `docker run -d` per service in depends_on order, and `docker network connect` for extra networks. Resolves YAML anchors and merge keys, rewrites ./relative bind mounts to ${PWD}/..., double-quotes ${VARIABLES} for the shell to expand (docker run does not read .env), turns $$ into a literal $, and maps ports, volumes (short and long syntax), environment, env_file, healthcheck, entrypoint/command, restart, deploy.resources limits and GPU reservations, ulimits, logging, labels and capabilities. Returns the script, the individual commands, the containers and warnings for keys with no docker run equivalent (secrets, configs, replicas). Parses only; nothing is executed.

multiline.description: One flag per line with \ continuations (default true); false gives one line per command

name: compose_to_docker_run
